MRK.rationale: MRK presents a moderately attractive fundamental case. The business trajectory is clearly accelerating: Q3 2025 showed revenue +9.3% QoQ to $17.28B, EPS +31.8% QoQ to $2.32, and operating cash flow of $7.82B (1.35x net income). Margins are structurally high and expanding — gross margin ~77.7%, operating margin ~39.1%, net margin ~33.5% in Q3, with trailing net margin stabilized at 0.296. ROE is strong at 36.7%. Q1 2026 earnings beat consensus on both revenue ($16.29B vs $15.82B est.) and adjusted EPS (- guidance was raised to $5.04–$5.16. New product momentum is real: WINREVAIR $525M (+88% YoY), Welireg $199M (+45%), KEYTRUDA QLEX $128M in its first quarter. Valuation is moderate — P/E of 14.3x is in the upper half of its 10.7–17.4x trailing range, no longer at the deep-value compression of mid-2025, but earnings yield of 7.0% still offers a meaningful 260bp spread over the 10-year Treasury. The stock is ~13% below its trailing high of $125.14, consolidating after a 24.5% rally. However, the Keytruda patent cliff (2028/2029) remains the dominant unresolved risk — QLEX at $128M is tiny relative to ~$30B+ annual Keytruda revenue. Gardasil's structural decline (19% Q1 2026, 39% FY2025) and recent pipeline setbacks (LITESPARK-012 failure, gefapixant CRL) add to transition uncertainty. The score reflects solid fundamentals and trajectory at a fair-to-slightly-cheap valuation, tempered by the magnitude of the patent-cliff overhang and the fact that the market has already partially re-rated the stock from its trough multiples.
